rules: UNKNOWN denominator yields UNKNOWN rate; zero denominator yields NOT_COMPUTABLE
Numerator and denominator must share unit, version, eligibility and method
Never combine membership, task, response, trajectory, property, claim, invocation or descriptor units
Retain missing, error, abstention, negative and excluded counts by reason
Report official results separately for every submode and component
Historical observed counts do not become fresh execution counts

metrics.evidence: future input and terminal shard receipts
metrics.limitations: source processing does not audit a claim or execute a task

metrics.numerator: selected tasks with at least one compatible authentic output
metrics.limitations: count one task once here; output occurrences reported separately

metrics.denominator: all required property instances under approved matrix
metrics.method: decision ledger count by predicate and verdict
metrics.limitations: does not infer semantic truth from source integrity

metrics.denominator: all attributable claims required by approved scope
metrics.method: attributable claims linked to sufficient evidence
metrics.limitations: abstentions and unattributable observations separately reported

metrics.numerator: task/output pairs with actual official results
metrics.denominator: all required eligible task/output pairs in the approved submode
metrics.code: official evaluator commit plus executed driver hash
metrics.evidence: input commitments, command, streams, exit and official result
metrics.limitations: partial function scoring is not full CLI, fresh tests or leaderboard score

metrics.numerator: checkpoint descriptors revalidated in fresh process
metrics.code: Engine commit and recovery driver hash
metrics.limitations: descriptor recovery does not authenticate producer or reconstruct missing source bodies
